title: Braised Winter Melon with Dried Shrimp

ingredients.name: winter melon
ingredients.rawText: 1 catty winter melon, peeled, deseeded and diced

ingredients.name: dried shrimp
ingredients.rawText: 2 tbsp dried shrimp, soaked until soft; reserve soaking water

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.rawText: 1 tsp salt, added after the melon softens

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.rawText: 1 tsp water for the slurry, plus water to soak the shrimp

ingredients.name: cooking oil
ingredients.rawText: Cooking oil, as needed to fry the aromatics

steps.text: Peel and deseed the winter melon and cut into cubes. Soak the dried shrimp until softened, reserving their soaking water.
Mix 1 tsp cornstarch with 1 tsp water to make a slurry.
Heat a little oil and fry the ginger, garlic and softened dried shrimp until fragrant.
Add the winter melon and stir to combine. Pour in the reserved shrimp soaking water, cover and braise over medium heat for about 5 minutes, until the melon is translucent and tender.
Add the salt, sugar, light soy sauce and oyster sauce only after the melon has softened, and mix well.
Stir the slurry again, pour it into the pan and simmer until the sauce thickens. Serve hot.

notes: Serves 2–3. Add the seasonings after the winter melon softens to preserve its natural sweetness.
